items.title: 1. Cream belly band paints the forelegs
items.evidence: 1_beauty az000: both forelegs brown shoulder to knee, one cream diamond on the chest; 2_closeups front limb colour: brown legs, only a small grey-cream scrap at the elbow.

items.title: 2. Eyes are slits
items.evidence: 1_beauty az000: two clearly visible dark round eyes at thumbnail; 2_closeups head colour: faceted almond eye; techqa float 0.

items.title: 3. Mane locks stand off as cards; mane ends in a skirt
items.evidence: 1_beauty hero: shoulder plate gone, 3_tech has no blue marks; but az000 mane still reads as a dark trapezoid with a jagged fringe and only a shallow V point, not the tapered V to mid-chest (builder admits shallow V).

items.title: 4. Antlers read as a rake
items.evidence: 1_beauty az000 and hero: tan antlers, tines up-and-out, small dark burr, slivers 1.7%; but az000 tip-to-tip spread is ~1.9 head widths (~183 px vs ~97 px head), above the 1.6 limit; tines still thin.

items.title: 5. Ears stick out sideways like wings
items.evidence: 1_beauty az000/back34: ears angle up with tips above roots, inside antler spread; techqa float 0, ear clip 0, total clip 8 tris (under 14).
